The family of the #Ebola patient—including his children—faced a high risk of infection. With Ebola often deadly in young children, the #CharitéBerlin team decided to use a preventive treatment for the first time. In our second Paper spotlight, the researchers share what they learned:

👉 https://www.charite.de/en/research/paper_spotlight/new_findings_on_preventive_treatment_after_exposure_to_bundibugyo_ebola_virus/
